name: Shroud of Icy Mist
body:
School conjuration (creation) [cold]; Level alchemist 1, bloodrager 1, druid/shaman 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a container of water)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

You create a swirling cold mist around the target granting them temporary hit points equal to 1d8+1/per caster level (max +5). Any adjacent creature that attacks the affected target or any creature attacking the target with a melee natural attack is dealt cold damage equal to the temporary hp from this spell that are lost.
